proposed_widenings.name: conditional_passive_family
proposed_widenings.justification: Arcane Apotheosis activates no action — it is a passive benefit that applies automatically inside another feature's active window (Innate Sorcery). The only ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which models features the player explicitly triggers. No family exists for 'passive rider scoped to another feature's active state'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While your Innate Sorcery feature is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

proposed_widenings.name: waive_resource_cost
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic reduces the Sorcery Point cost of one Metamagic use per turn to zero. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant expresses cost-waiving on a class resource. Current variants are 'grant_extra_action' and 'heal_hp' only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it

proposed_widenings.name: sorcery_points
proposed_widenings.justification: Sorcery Points are a sorcerer-specific resource pool (Font of Magic) distinct from use_count, spell_slot, and charge. The surface has no resource atom for this pool, which funds both Metamagic options and spell-slot conversions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: without spending Sorcery Points on it

proposed_widenings.name: metamagic_use
proposed_widenings.justification: Metamagic is a sorcerer-specific spell-modification system (Quickened, Twinned, Empowered, etc.) triggered at cast time using Sorcery Points. It does not fit any existing window or procedure atom. Encoding Arcane Apotheosis requires naming the thing whose cost is being waived.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it

notes: The primary blocker is structural: 'activation' forces a player-triggered event that does not exist for this feature. Arcane Apotheosis is a scope-bound passive modifier — it silently changes the cost of Metamagic while Innate Sorcery is up, with no activation event of its own. Secondary blockers: Sorcery Points are not a modeled resource, Metamagic is not a modeled procedure/system, and there is no effect atom for cost-waiving. All four gaps would need to be closed before this unit could be encoded honestly.
